lines.en: I yell as I walk, never pausing

lines.zh: 我一步一步踏在空地上
lines.en: I tread step by step on open ground
My shouting makes the grass tremble
I walk toward the sound

lines.zh: 我的脚步很重，喊声更重
lines.en: My steps are heavy, my voice heavier
I go around the blocking stones
I stop to finish this one yell

lines.zh: 我走过的地方鸟都不叫了
lines.en: Where I pass, the birds stop singing
I swing my arms as I go
I head for that house

lines.zh: 我的喊声在树间弹回来
lines.en: My voice bounces between trees

lines.zh: 我越走越快，喊得也越快
lines.en: I go faster, and shout faster
I stand in the middle of the clearing and yell
My throat rises and falls
The yell stops; the air still rings
I open my mouth and yell again
I raise my head to the sky

lines.zh: 我听见自己在喊的回音
lines.en: I hear my own echo
My hands hang at my sides, shaking
I yell until there's no air left
Every bird far off has flown
I turn to another direction and continue
I need no reason to yell

lines.zh: 喊声从我身体里出来，比我大
lines.en: The yell comes out bigger than I am
I stand there, chest heaving
Sound carries far in this clearing
You heard that, didn't you
I stop and look at you
My yelling is aimed at you now
Your hands are over your ears
I'll yell until you answer
My mouth is open very wide
Your face has changed

lines.zh: 我喊你的名字，虽然不知道
lines.en: I yell your name, though I don't know it
You step away and I yell again
I stare at you without blinking
You can't escape this sound
I raise a hand and point at you
As long as you hear it
I've started walking toward you
Don't pretend you didn't hear
I bring my head close and yell at you
You raise your voice; I lower mine
I copy the shape of your mouth; it comes out wrong
I wait for you to answer back

lines.zh: 你不说话，我就再喊一次
lines.en: You stay silent, so I yell once more

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，比刚才更响
lines.en: I roar once, louder than before
I bend over, hands on my knees
I step back and my yell cuts off

lines.zh: 我按住被打中的那一处
lines.en: I press the spot I was struck
I raise my head, throat swelling
The blow knocks me back and I hold
I start yelling faster
I shudder and stand firm
I stare at you and my voice drops
That thing in your hand makes noise
A sound! I want to hear it clearly
I come closer just to hear it better
You try shouting too
I yell once, and you yell too
That sound is much smaller than mine
Shake it again
I reach out and you back away
It stopped, and I'm displeased
I want to hear that sound again
You hit me and I roar louder
I crowd you against a trunk

lines.zh: 我的胸口撞得你退了两步
lines.en: My chest knocks you back two steps
You duck under my arm

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音炸开
lines.en: We collide and the noise bursts out
My hand catches your shoulder
I crash through a thicket
Your ears are ringing
I step back, still yelling
You squeeze past me here
Another yell answers far off
We yell together, louder still
It's taller and shouts lower
We walk one behind the other
Two voices collide in the air
It tires, and I take over
We stand at opposite ends of the clearing
We've driven off every bird
This area will be much noisier
We need nothing else
I snatch it up one-handed, still yelling
It crunches in my grip
I raise it to my mouth, meaning to bite
It won't fill a gap in my teeth
I fling it far away
It hits the ground and I laugh
I stuff it into my chest
I drop it and keep yelling
I'll take it and go
Your steps make me turn my head
I yell toward you
I've started toward you
This clearing is too small for you

lines.zh: 我的手在地上抓了一把土
lines.en: I scoop up a fistful of earth
Hiding behind a tree is fine

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把树撞开
lines.en: I walk and shoulder the tree aside

lines.zh: 我开始砸那些挡路的东西
lines.en: I start smashing whatever blocks me

lines.zh: 你要是挖洞，我就挖下去
lines.en: If you dig, I'll dig after you
If you build up, I can still reach

lines.zh: 这里没有路可以让你跑远
lines.en: There's no path to get far from me
You'll hear me louder when you run
I pause once, then go faster
Your scent is right ahead
I'm already on my way to you
I follow you step by step, yelling
You go around a tree; I push it down

lines.zh: 你往高爬，我抓着石头上去
lines.en: You climb; I pull myself up by the stones
I widen the hole you dug
My yelling gets closer
Clods of dirt fly from my feet
I don't stop and I don't pant

lines.zh: 你听得到墙那边我的声音
lines.en: You hear me through the wall

lines.zh: 我把挡路的东西一件件拆了
lines.en: I take apart whatever's in the way
Where you're hiding isn't deep enough
I follow the sound of your steps
You can't keep a straight line
There's no way around me here
I smash as I walk
Don't stop to catch your breath

lines.zh: 我的声音就是我的方向
lines.en: My voice is my direction
I'm very close
Listen; I've yelled again
I dig the hole open from above

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，土飞起来
lines.en: I hammer down and dirt sprays
I grab you and drive you to the ground

lines.zh: 我的肩膀撞开你的防御
lines.en: My shoulder breaks through your guard
The noise leaves you unsteady
I swing my arm in a wide sweep

lines.zh: 这一下砸在树上，树折了
lines.en: That blow snaps the tree
I throw you a couple of meters
There's a dent in your armor now
I hold you down, still yelling
You kick at me, struggling
I raise a foot and stomp
You roll clear, leaving a crater
I catch your leg and drag
This yell lands right at your ear
You fall back to the edge of the clearing
I follow you without pausing
The first yell comes from far off

lines.zh: 空地那头出现一个高影子
lines.en: A tall shape appears at the far end
I start yelling and never stop

lines.zh: 树木之间的鸟一起飞了
lines.en: All the birds between the trees take flight
I take the first step and the ground answers
The sound is like no animal at all

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把草踩平
lines.en: I flatten the grass as I come
This open ground suits me
My mouth opens and the sound arrives first
You hear me long before you see me
I'm looking for something that answers

lines.zh: 我来了，来喊给这片地听
lines.en: I've come to yell at this land

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，声音更长
lines.en: My shadow is long; my voice is longer
My hands close into fists at my sides
I look up and see the house
I have no need to hide

lines.zh: 我开始砸最近的那棵树
lines.en: I start smashing the nearest tree

lines.zh: 我的声音在树间来回撞
lines.en: My voice rebounds between the trees
You heard it; look this way
This place won't be quiet today

lines.zh: 火烧到我，我叫声变了调
lines.en: Fire catches me and my voice breaks pitch

lines.zh: 水灌进我喉咙，喊不出来
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I can't yell

lines.zh: 爆炸把我整个人掀离地
lines.en: The blast lifts me off my feet
An arrow sticks in my shoulder
Magic clamps my throat shut
I've yelled too long; I'm empty

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我的喊声被劈断
lines.en: Lightning hits me and severs my yell

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我的喊声也掉下去了
lines.en: Nothing below, and my yell falls with me
